correctness.rationale: With generator L, antiderivatives in each coordinate establish the three conditional regressions from invariance. Stationarity of x^2 and z gives h=E[z]=E[x^2]=E[xy]; h=0 would force x=0 and contradict c>0 in the mean y equation. Orthogonality of residual R=y-x gives Var(y)=Var(x)+s, s=E[R^2]. Direct differentiation of V=x^2/sigma+y^2+z^2 yields Var(z)+s=h(r-1-h)+cm. By Cauchy m<=sqrt(h)=q, so q^3-(r-1)q-c<=0, and the cubic has one positive root xi+. Equality forces m=q, s=Var(z)=Var(x)=0 and hence the positive equilibrium atom. The zero-speed-defect support must be equilibrium by the 1D z-flow and invariance. The independent exact rational algebra and high-precision numerical-root checks agree, but neither substitutes for the generator proof.
